Stranded: Isle Survival uses Unity In-App Purchasing (IAP) to let you buy virtual items, currency, or content within the Game.

🐚 Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 26, 2026

🔒 Your Data 🏝️ Stranded: Isle Survival

We know a privacy policy isn't as fun as building your own tropical hideaway, but it's important! This Privacy Policy explains what information is collected when you play Stranded: Isle Survival (the "Game"), and how it's used.

🐠 1. Information We Collect

We don't ask you to create an account or hand over personal details to play. However, some information is automatically collected by the third-party services built into the Game:

  • Device identifiers (like your advertising ID) used for showing and measuring ads.
  • Gameplay and technical data such as device type, operating system, crash reports, and in-game events, used to keep the Game running smoothly.
  • Purchase information processed when you make an in-app purchase, handled by the app store and our IAP provider.

🐠 2. Google Ads (AdMob)

We use Google Ads / AdMob to show ads in the Game. Google may collect and use data (such as your advertising identifier and general device information) to serve ads, including personalized ads, in line with your device and regional privacy settings.

🔎 You can learn more about how Google handles this data, and manage your ad personalization settings, at Google's Ads Policy page.

🐠 3. Unity In-App Purchasing (IAP)

We use Unity IAP to process purchases made inside the Game. When you make a purchase, transaction details are handled by Unity and the app store (Apple App Store or Google Play) to complete and verify the purchase. We do not directly store your payment card information.

🐠 4. How We Use Information

  • To operate, maintain, and improve the Game.
  • To display ads and measure their performance.
  • To process and verify in-app purchases.
  • To fix bugs and understand crash reports.

🐠 5. Children's Privacy

Stranded: Isle Survival is intended for a general audience. If the Game is directed at children, or if we become aware a child under the applicable age of consent has provided personal information without appropriate consent, we will take steps to comply with applicable laws such as COPPA, including limiting ads shown to child-directed traffic through Google's certified tools.

🐠 6. Data Sharing

We share limited data only with the third-party services that make the Game work — Google (for ads) and Unity (for in-app purchases) — as described above. We do not sell your personal information.

🐠 7. Your Choices

  • You can reset or limit your device's advertising identifier in your device settings at any time.
  • You can opt out of personalized ads through your device's privacy settings or Google's ad settings.

🐠 8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally. Changes will be posted here with a new "Last updated" date.
